purpose: User-authorized deadline predictions only; no scientific qualification or external submission by this runner.

6.selection_source: Pre-existing task6_development_v2.json selected_configuration; no held-out confirmation

7.settings: Use unchanged ghist_single_sweep.background.SETTINGS and shared predict_task7_sweep_bgs.run

8.mask_policy: Entire inclusive RAiSD SNP span must be callable
8.reference_background: Maximum callable Task7 RAiSD score strictly farther than2000000bp from its own highest callable RAiSD peak; observed cross-task heuristic, NOT a matched or calibrated null
8.peak_selection: All strictly above-threshold peaks, ordered by decreasing score with genomic-position tie break, separated by at least1000000bp; never a fixed peak count
8.exons: Intersect final chr9 exons with callable mask before nearest-base snapping; ties choose smallest coordinate
8.zero_candidate_fallback: Exactly one highest callable Task8 RAiSD peak; nearest callable exonic base within60000bp if available, otherwise unsnapped callable peak; explicitly unsupported best guess
8.missing_reference_background_fallback: Same single highest callable Task8 peak; record reason; do not invent a null threshold
limitations: Task7 and Task8 demographies are not matched.
Transferred threshold is a heuristic with no familywise-error, precision, recall, or coverage guarantee.
One-peak fallback does not infer the true count.

final_bed_geometry.policy: Keep each method raw candidate. For deadline BED only, move an inaccessible center to nearest callable base (ties lower coordinate), intersect its fixed-width interval with the containing callable component and [0,contig_length), then merge overlaps for Task8. Record every adjustment; no width/threshold tuning.

provenance: Input/source/runtime hashes bound before inference and verified after; chr9, exact contig/mask/exon bounds, phased SNP contract and final BED validation required; originals and all failures retained.
